fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
fields.leveling: {{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
fields.description2: After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
fields.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
fields.notes:
* Her attack commands during this time are switched to movement commands instead. Upon finishing the charge and if an attack command was issued, '''Kai'Sa''' will continue walking toward her target.
** '''Kai'Sa''' behaves normally if attack move click was issued not on a target during the cast time, stopping at attack range of the closest target and starts attacking when charged up.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
